question: For SME customers who transact in Czech koruna (CZK), identify the month in 2013 with the highest gas consumption. Additionally, compute how many more such customers exist compared to SME customers using euros (EUR), and return both the top month and this customer count difference.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_month AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2) AS month
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'SME'
      AND T1."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2)
    ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN "XCL_003" = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS czk_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN "XCL_003" = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eur_count
    FROM customers
    WHERE "XCL_002" = 'SME'
)
SELECT 
    tm.month,
    (c.czk_count - c.eur_count) AS customer_count_difference
FROM top_month tm
CROSS JOIN counts c;

WITH top_month AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2) AS month
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'SME'
      AND T1."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2)
    ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN "XCL_003" = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS czk_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN "XCL_003" = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eur_count
    FROM customers
    WHERE "XCL_002" = 'SME'
)
SELECT 
    tm.month,
    (c.czk_count - c.eur_count) AS customer_count_difference
FROM top_month tm
CROSS JOIN counts c;

WITH top_month AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2) AS month
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'SME'
      AND T1."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2)
    ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN "XCL_003" = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS czk_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN "XCL_003" = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eur_count
    FROM customers
    WHERE "XCL_002" = 'SME'
)
SELECT 
    tm.month,
    (c.czk_count - c.eur_count) AS customer_count_difference
FROM top_month tm
CROSS JOIN counts c;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH sme_czk AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001
    FROM customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
      AND t.XCL_012 = 'CZK'
),
sme_eur AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001
    FROM customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
      AND t.XCL_012 = 'EUR'
),
monthly_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', t.XCL_011) AS month,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
      AND t.XCL_012 = 'CZK'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2013'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', t.XCL_011)
),
top_month AS (
    SELECT month
    FROM monthly_consumption
    ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
counts AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sme_czk) AS czk_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sme_eur) AS eur_count
)
SELECT 
    tm.month AS top_month,
    (c.czk_count - c.eur_count) AS customer_count_difference
FROM top_month tm
CROSS JOIN counts c
